description: Find Medium articles by tag, author, publication, keyword search, or direct URL.

articleUrl.description: One or more article URLs, separated by new lines or commas. Medium URLs, custom-domain Medium articles, and `medium.com/p/...` links are accepted.
articleUrl.title: Article URLs

containsKeyword.description: Only keep articles whose title or preview text contains this keyword (case-insensitive).
containsKeyword.title: Title/preview contains

customTag.description: Use any Medium tag slug that is not in the list above. When set, it overrides the Tag selection.
customTag.title: Custom tag slug (optional)

excludePaywalled.description: When enabled, member-only (paywalled) articles are skipped.
excludePaywalled.title: Exclude member-only articles

fromDate.description: Only keep articles published on or after this ISO date (for example `2025-01-01`).
fromDate.title: Published on or after

maxItems.description: Maximum number of article records to save. Pagination stops when this number is reached or the source runs out.
maxItems.title: Maximum articles

mode.description: Choose how to find articles: browse a tag, list an author's posts, list a publication's posts, search by keyword, or look up article URLs.
mode.title: Discovery mode

publication.description: Publication slug as it appears in the URL (for example `towards-data-science`) or a full publication URL. Used by the publication mode.
publication.title: Publication slug or URL

query.description: Keywords to search for across Medium articles. Used by the search mode.
query.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Order for tag browsing: newest first, or the most-clapped stories from the past week, month, or year.
sortBy.title: Tag order

tag.description: Tag to browse. Pick a common topic or use the matching value in the dropdown; the latest or most-clapped stories for that tag are collected.
tag.title: Tag

username.description: Medium username (for example `towardsdatascience`) or a profile URL such as `https://medium.com/@towardsdatascience`. Used by the author mode.
username.title: Author username or profile URL

title: Medium Article Discovery & Metadata Input
